'''Stunners''' were small, hand-held weapons used to temporarily paralyze opponents. They were capable of causing minimal, non-lethal damage to an intended target. A small thong was attached to the device, which could be wrapped around the user's hand with the disk itself placed upon the palm. By activating the power cell, the wearer could discharge a field of energy emanating from an aperture within the center of the disk. Targets within range of the weapon fell immediately unconscious upon being struck by the energy charge. Visually, the stun effect resembled the spherical rings of energy, discharged from an [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 blaster rifle]].

==History==
[[File:Kleb_zellock-Dirconite.png|thumb|150px|[[Kleb Zellock]] holding a stunner]]During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], stunners were used by the [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guards]], though rarely-seen by others. After disrupting the [[Confederate–Republic peace conference/Legends|Confederate–Republic peace conference]] being held on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]], [[Lux Bonteri/Legends|Lux Bonteri]] used a stunner to incapacitate [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] to prevent her from taking him to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

[[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions]] manufactured the [[Model 31 palm stunner/Legends|Model 31]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="EV" /> In [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]] on the planet [[Tyne's Horky]], [[Kleb Zellock]] tried and failed to use a mini-stunner on [[Jann Tosh]] and his droids [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]. Instead, [[Jessica Meade]] used it on Zellock.<ref name="The Lost Prince">{{DroidsCite|The Lost Prince}}</ref> Sometime later, the pirate [[Jyn Obah]] likewise used a stunner to incapacitate several guards at the castle of [[Mon Julpa]] on [[Tammuz-an/Legends|Tammuz-an]]. He and his captain Kybo Ren also used the device against Jann, King Mon Julpa, and Princess [[Gerin Toda]].<ref name="The Revenge of Kybo Ren">{{DroidsCite|The Revenge of Kybo Ren}}</ref>
